native_mechanisms: Order is fixed by placement at the riverbank (silence-swats), so a mark's position is carried by where it lands, never by when it is folded.

Each even-count heap races the musk deer's mountain stride — uphill twist, downhill fold, doubling back — until no heap keeps the shape it entered with, the running shape carried forward into the next heap.

The result is searched in squares: turn the shape ninety degrees and fold its corners into its own centre, repeatedly, until one changed mark smears across every square (verified by the one-mark-flip test).
The owl calls the final folded shape inside the dreamer inside, sealing it to one fixed size, while every intermediate heap is burned so the token cannot be walked back to its marks.
core_technique: 16×64-bit state held as 4 parallel lanes absorbing 32-byte stripes with a SipRound-style ARX permutation (add/rotate/xor) per lane plus a per-stripe cross-lane rotational shuffle for diffusion, then 3 blank rounds, a 4×4 diagonal XOR fold with length injection, and a double murmur3 fmix64 finalizer (with an XXH3-style overlapping-read path for len<32 and the tail).
